Thanks for flagging the conflict, Julia — we can move. Wed Aug 13 at 11:00 AM PT works for our team; I'll update the invite if Soojin confirms.

Per Soojin's note, we've started a parking-lot doc to make the deep-dive efficient. Below are the engineering items we've collected so far (please add):

Parking-lot (initial):
- Authentication & tokens: are you expecting OAuth2 / short-lived keys for read-only embedding calls? What KMS/HSM flow do you prefer for key rotation?
- Long context handling: expected session length and approach to KV cache across user sessions (sticky routing or stateless cache?)
- Deployment topology: are you planning a hosted API for inference or a dedicated/private deployment behind VPC? Any constraints on egress/ingress?
- Quantization tradeoffs: do you require FP16 or prefer 8-bit quantized models for cost savings? Any regulatory constraints on model fidelity for certain workloads?
- Data retention/audit: what retention window is acceptable for request logs and KV cache persistence?

Quick asks for Acme engineers before the call:
- Share any network diagrams showing where inference endpoints will be invoked from (ip ranges, VPC peering).
- Any redlines on encryption or routing that would change our recommended topology.

I've attached preliminary design notes we referenced (prelim-design-notes.md). If you can drop answers inline or add to the shared drive, we'll incorporate them into the session deck.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
